info.name: Motrix Download Manager
info.summary: Seamless download manager for Nextcloud powered by Motrix
info.description: Motrix integration for Nextcloud: - Add HTTP/HTTPS, FTP, Magnet links, and Torrents directly to Motrix - Monitor real-time download progress, speeds, and ETA - Automatically sync completed files directly into your Nextcloud storage - Pause, resume, and remove active downloads - Powered by Motrix MDXP (JSON-RPC 2.0)
info.author: Nio
